purpose: Build and validate the separately packaged, demo-only Exness MT5 execution lane required for DEMO-ADMIT without changing or deploying the execution-disabled PCR-3 release.
implementation_constraints: Do not modify the sealed PCR-3 release.
Do not deploy to the VPS during implementation preparation.
Do not enable MT5 external Python trading during implementation preparation.
Do not submit, modify, cancel, or close any demo or live order without separate APC-DEMO activation approval.
Keep the demo adapter outside the production-candidate package capability boundary.

Fail closed on account identity mismatch, non-XAUUSD symbol, volume above 0.01 lot, nonzero pre-existing exposure, missing protective stop, stale or unknown reconciliation state, or uncertain submission outcome.
